scope: checkpoint-free pinned-vLLM FP8 consumer bridge and its conditional same-session BF16 ParallelLMHead arm

evidence: The controller has no systemd-run, INVOCATION_ID, or SYSTEMD_EXEC_PID owner gate.
It invokes a detached cleanup watchdog, but that watchdog does not own or sequence scientific work.
Its run() has one remote runner, retrieves one allocation result, then unconditionally delete_instance() in finally.
It has no typed primary-success evaluator, retained-instance handoff, conditional ParallelLMHead trigger, or false-trigger cleanup branch.
controller_audit.contract_failure: The project requires one durable sequential owner that persists every actual-consumer stage and can start the BF16 ParallelLMHead arm only after the typed FP8 primary result. Running this foreground controller under an ad-hoc wrapper would not establish a controller-owned retained session and would still unconditionally tear down before the conditional arm.

provider_precreate_gate.reason: The only named controller that accepts the custom scripts fails the mandatory durable-owner and conditional-arm semantics before any provider mutation.

required_next_move: Use an existing shared durable controller that can accept custom remote/benchmark inputs and has one typed sequential retained-session evaluator, or explicitly authorize its narrowly scoped implementation and its owner-gate tests. Revalidate these immutable identities before any create; do not use a standalone systemd wrapper around mla_microbench_control.py.
